newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Perkin-Elmer Corp Q4 June 30 net.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Perkin-Elmer Corp Q4 June 30 net.

text.p: (All Data Omits 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTES: Company said Q4 per share before special items was $0.85 vs $0.63.

1997 net includes Q4 restructuring pretax charge $24.2 million, equal to $15.5 million, or $0.34/shr, partially offset by pretax reversal of 1996 charge of $11.2 million, equal to $6.7 million, or $0.15/shr, after taxes. Q4 also includes after-tax charges $1.4 million, or $0.03/shr, for purchased R&D and $6.8 million, or $0.15/shr, on adoption of FASB 121 on goodwill writedowns.
1997 year net also includes gain $28.8 million, or $0.65/shr, on sale of investment and charge $25.4 million, or $0.57/shr, for purchased R&D.

1996 special items include pretax restructuring charge of $71.6 million, equal to $62.3 million, or $1.44/shr, after taxes; charge $27.1 million, or $0.62/shr, for purchased R&D; amd gain $9.0 million, or $0.21, on sale of investment.
